laws.full_text_french: Loi No. 64 du 26 octobre 2017

key_articles.text_french: Fixation de l'impôt sur les intérêts à 7%
key_articles.text_english: Tax on interest revenue set at 7% on interest and revenues from savings accounts, bank deposits, bonds, treasury bills
key_articles.subject: Interest Tax Rate

laws.historical_context: Law No. 64/2017 increased the tax on interest revenue to 7%, replacing previous rates. This is a final withholding tax that cannot be refunded or credited.
